scientific_integrity: An analytic proof treats all n>=2; a standalone exact checker compares small complete Walsh arrays and parameter-class sums. Finite checks do not certify the infinite proof. No independent scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact zero classification and norm concern only size-two matchings of the complete bipartite graph with three fixed left vertices; no quantitative rate for the asymptotic or exhaustive historical priority is claimed.
title: Exact zero-free residues and sharp Fourier norms for two-edge matchings in \(K_{3,n}\)
